name: Escuela de Pinamar
source:
Our protagonist moves from the boring rural town, where he will met interesting people.

When coming back from school, he falls into a subworld where he should find a way to wake up, depending on where he goes, story will change. Discover the 10 endings (translation of the Itch.io page)
translation:
我们的男主角搬离了沉闷乏味的乡间小镇，在新环境里结识了一群有趣的人。

某天放学回家的路上，他意外跌入了一个里世界，必须设法从中醒来。根据他前往的地点不同，故事走向也将随之改变。快来探索全部10种结局吧。（译自itch.io页面）
